strategy.label: top-down model: the two reagents the dataset names, amounts from the addition equation with molar masses, utilities calibrated
strategy.note: NOT S1. Althaus (2007) lists this dataset in Tab. 1.1 as 'Reported in: Part II', but the 957-page report has no acetone-cyanohydrin chapter - the index points at a chapter the report does not contain (see the locate response). The dataset's own ecoSpold technology field, 'production from acetone and hydrogen cyanide by base-catalyzed reaction', names both reagents and the catalysis. C3H6O (acetone, 58.080) + HCN (27.026) -> C4H7NO (acetone cyanohydrin, 85.106); a pure addition, 85.106 = 85.106, so the two reagents add up to exactly 1.000 kg per kg of product: 58.080/85.106 = 0.68244 kg of acetone and 27.026/85.106 = 0.31756 kg of hydrogen cyanide. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990. This is the one reaction in the whole set with no co-product and no yield ambiguity: it is a 1:1 addition and the masses close exactly, so the amounts are fixed. Both reagents are themselves unflagged eco-profiles in this same set - and both are rebuilt here from the Althaus report (acetone from the cumene figure, hydrogen cyanide from Tab. 43.2/43.3/43.4) - so this is the deepest chain in the set. It is linked to the BAFU datasets rather than to those rebuilds so that its check measures its own evidence; re-point with `sandbox` to chain them. The base catalyst is a gap: named, never quantified.

evidence.where: Cumene / Ethyl benzene / Phosgene / Aniline, at plant [RER]
evidence.note: BAFU template, not a report figure. Every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU-2026 carries the same five-line utility block: 0.333 kWh of 'Electricity, medium voltage, production ENTSO-E, at grid', 2.0 MJ of 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' [CH], 4.0E-10 units of 'Chemical plant, organics', and transport at 0.6 tkm rail + 0.1 tkm lorry per kilogram of precursor. Verified exchange by exchange on Cumene, at plant (0.684 kg benzene + 0.369 kg propylene = 1.053 kg of precursor -> 0.632 tkm rail, 0.105 tkm lorry), Ethyl benzene, at plant (1.030 -> 0.619 / 0.103), Phosgene, liquid, at plant (1.040 -> 0.624 / 0.104) and Aniline, at plant (1.352 -> 0.814 / 0.136). That is the named template this amount comes from.

node.name: xx Acetone cyanohydrin, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: Base-catalysed addition of HCN to acetone, per kg of acetone cyanohydrin. The eight waste-treatment services that the BAFU dataset already carries as explicit exchanges are deliberately not part of this model - they were never collapsed away - following the committed PlasticsEurope specs. The consequence, measured in results/checks/, is that the target's cumulative vector gets a long tail of flows from those disposal chains that no model omitting them can reach.
